contentText:
Charli xcx, GloRilla, PinkPantheress, Tinashe, Rüfüs Du Sol, Empire of the Sun and Sienna Spiro are just some of the artists you can expect to see at Outside Lands 2026.

Tetris Kelly: Outside Lands is almost here, and Billboard News is getting you ready for one of the biggest weekends in music. From the artists you can’t miss to the moments everyone will be talking about, here’s your festival preview.

Let’s start with the main stage moments. This year’s lineup brings some of music’s biggest names to Golden Gate Park, including some powerhouse girls like Charli xcx, GloRilla, PinkPantheress and Tinashe. We better get that new single. And can’t forget the fellas like Empire of the Sun and Rüfüs Du Sol. Whether you’re there for the massive hits, the unforgettable live performances, or finally seeing a favorite artist in person, these are the sets that fans will be counting down to.

But some of the best festival moments happen when you discover an artist you didn’t know you needed. Like, keep an eye out for Sienna Spiro. These rising stars are bringing some of the most exciting sounds and music right now, and Outside Lands could be the place where their next big moment happens.
